name: Parameters.placePerm_spec
summary: σ∘Φ_1 is the chosen embedding at its place w_σ (both are K-embeddings with the same place), then compose with galOfPlace(P, s)(v).

steps.claim: The K-embeddings σ ∘ Φ_1 and Φ_{w_σ}, w_σ = mk(σ ∘ Φ_1), define the same place, so they are equal (`algHom_eq_of_mk_eq`, `mk_Φ`); then for v: σ(Φ_v(x)) = σ(Φ_1(galOfPlace(P, s)(v) x)) = Φ_{w_σ}(galOfPlace(P, s)(v) x) = Φ_{w_σ·v}(x) (`phi_mul`), and w_σ·v = placePerm(s, σ)(v).
steps.lean:
simpa [placePerm,
    Φ] using! congr($(@algHom_eq_of_mk_eq P s _ (.comp σ ⟨Φ 1, by simp⟩) (mk_Φ _)) _).symm
